notes:
Changes since 0.1.0-beta.13.

### Added

- **Continuity Checker.** In a local project, choose **Check continuity**, pick the Notes or Blank document that holds your story plan as the master, and select the writing to check. Stela compares the writing with the master and with itself, records each discrepancy in a **Continuity issues** section of the master, and asks up to three questions per check. Notes, Blank documents, Novels, Screenplays, and Articles can be checked, and you can keep writing while a check runs.
- Open continuity issues are highlighted in your writing. Open a highlight, or step through the issues with the controls above the document, to read the explanation and follow links between the passage and its entry in the master. The **Highlights** switch hides the marks and keeps the issue list and links.
- **Resolve…** on an issue opens one dialog to answer the checker's waiting questions or to close the issue as Resolved, Intentional, or Dismissed, with an optional note. It is in the issue list, in the explanation, and on the issue's card in the master. **Undo continuity check** reverses one saved check as a group.
- On Windows, Stela draws its own title bar with File, Edit, View, and Help menus, the document's name, and the window buttons. Alt, F10, and Alt with a menu's letter open the menus. On macOS, the window controls sit inside the sidebar and File gains **Open a Copy** and **Import and Split Document**.
- Scale the whole interface from 80% to 200% with Ctrl and =, -, or 0, or in Settings → Appearance. A **Match system** theme follows your computer's light or dark setting. On macOS, use Command for the Ctrl shortcuts.
- Open Markdown, plain text, and Fountain files from the file manager. Stela appears in **Open With** for these types, opens files passed to a running window, and adds opened files to Windows Recent and the jump list.
- On Windows, right-click a misspelled word in the editor, a screenplay, or an ad script for suggestions and **Add to dictionary**.
- Long Markdown documents with chapter headings open one chapter at a time. The other chapters fold to their title, word count, and comments, and open when you click them, move the caret past the open chapter, use the outline, follow a search result, or go to a comment. The document saves exactly as before.
- Settings → General has **Copy diagnostics** and **Open log folder**. After a crash, Stela tells you once on the next start. If the interface fails, an error screen offers Reload and Copy diagnostics.

### Improved

- Typing stays quick in long novels, screenplays, and ad scripts. Screenplays and ad scripts lay out only the part near the view.
- Find in Files uses a search index, shows the first results sooner, and no longer slows down when a phrase appears in every document.
- Exports, compiled manuscripts, packages, and asset downloads use the system Save dialog. Web and email links open in your browser or mail app; hold Ctrl or Command and click to open a link while writing.
- Questions and warnings appear in Stela's own themed dialogs, with the buttons in the order your platform uses. Problems stay in the status bar until you dismiss them.
- The window remembers its size and position, opens in the theme you last used, and keeps to one running copy. The first screen offers Start writing, an Open menu, and the sample novel.
- Unsaved writing is kept in recovery files that are written after a short pause and whenever you leave the window. Stela keeps your 50 most recent manual and automatic save points for each document.
- Permanent deletes, Empty Trash, and the 30-day trash cleanup send files to the Recycle Bin or Trash instead of erasing them.
- Documents renamed or moved outside Stela keep their place in the project, their open editor, recovery data, and save points. Connected folders are watched for changes: an unchanged open document reloads, an edited one is flagged, and sync conflict copies are reported once.
- Opening a workspace that is open in Stela on another computer asks before continuing, so two copies do not write the same project.
- Reduced-motion and high-contrast settings are respected, and tooltips follow the theme.

### Fixed

- Diagrams inserted with `/mermaid` stay diagrams when the document is saved, reopened, and exported. Printed and exported pages draw diagrams as images and no longer load a script from the internet.
- Browser shortcuts such as reload, print, and history no longer reach the window on Windows, including while an enlarged image is open. Ctrl+P, Ctrl+F, and Ctrl+Shift+R keep their Stela actions.
- A "database is locked" error during first-run setup, and save points made in the same moment being pruned in the wrong order.
- The links and icons at the bottom of the sidebar line up.

### Compatibility and installation notes

- The Continuity Checker sends the selected writing, relevant master excerpts, and summaries of recorded issues to the AI provider in your settings. Its findings were reviewed with one model, OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Sol; other providers and models have not been reviewed. Read a finding and its passages before changing your story plan.
- Settings move from the app's browser storage to a settings file the first time this version starts. Older betas do not read that file and start with default settings if you go back.
- Each local workspace gains a `.stela` folder that records its projects, folders, and document order. Keep it with the workspace when you sync or back up.
- The installer offers Stela in Open With without making it the default app for Markdown, text, or Fountain files.
- Diagrams that an earlier beta saved as plain text have to be inserted again.
- Spelling suggestions in the right-click menu are available on Windows only in this release.
- Beta.7 and later can update through Settings → Updates once this release is published. Earlier betas require one manual install. Beta and stable update channels remain separate.

### Security maintenance

- The app window can no longer write, rename, or delete files or start programs by itself. File changes go through checked native commands limited to the folders you granted, and release builds enforce a content security policy.
- Diagrams in the editor are drawn at Mermaid's strict security level, which removes script links and event handlers.
- Remove an unused storage plugin that could write a file at any path. Moving settings to the settings file also clears an AI key left in browser storage by betas older than the credential vault.
